_comment: SYNCED BASE — `bun run up` overwrites this file. Do not edit it here.
It exists for one reason: the path aliases below are the contract every
synced file imports through. When the whole tsconfig was project-owned, a
new upstream alias landed in synced code that the project's config had
never learned, and the import failed to resolve in a file nobody had
touched. Shipping the aliases separately from the project's own shape is
The project's `tsconfig.json` extends this and owns `include` / `exclude`.
To override a compiler option, redeclare it there: `extends` merges
`compilerOptions` key by key, so a single option overrides cleanly. The
one exception is `paths`, which replaces the whole map rather than merging
— a project adding its own alias copies this map and appends to it, and
then stops receiving new upstream aliases, which is the trade it is making.
